summary: FAIL: 1 major finding in spec_fidelity dimension. FIND-101 (major): REQ-AUTH-004 edge cases explicitly require 401 for absent/expired/consumed link session tokens, but the implementation returns 200 {linked: false} for all invalid conditions. The session endpoint never returns 401 except via the 403 Origin check. This is a spec fidelity violation: the acceptance criteria say 'Any invalid condition -> 401' and the edge case list enumerates 4 conditions each mapped to 401. All 3 prior critical findings (FIND-001, FIND-002, FIND-003) are resolved. 12 of 14 prior findings are fully resolved, 2 are partially resolved (FIND-006 legacy handler still has hardcoded values; FIND-007 session endpoint returns 200 not 401). 4 additional minor findings: FIND-102 (legacy handler hardcoded values persisting in test paths), FIND-103 (tautological legacy-path test in PROP-AUTH-012), FIND-104 (PROP-AUTH-020 does not spawn process), FIND-105 (discordClientSecret missing from config type). The pass threshold requires 0 critical and at most 2 major findings. With 1 major finding (FIND-101), this is close but spec_fidelity dimension FAILs because the 401 vs 200 divergence affects REQ-AUTH-004 acceptance criteria directly.
